purpose: The agent proposes modeling_input plus validation_plan, investigates failures and revises the decision. These are declarations to check against evidence, not scientifically validated defaults.

workflow_policy.followup_requirement: Use plan_followup with a current assessment fingerprint, scientific question, hypothesis IDs, why cofold is insufficient, expected information and decisions under support/refutation. Nonproductive geometry can motivate a follow-up; unresolved identity, completeness or provenance cannot.
workflow_policy.result_scope: Dynamics/design results stay separate and cannot satisfy or retroactively validate the primary cofolding requirement.

proposal.modeling_input: Provide the complete model object, OR use modeling_input_from with optional modeling_input_changes.
proposal.modeling_input_from: candidate | current: explicitly copy that model proposal, with no inherited execution or validation pass
proposal.modeling_input_changes: Optional JSON merge patch: nested objects merge, arrays replace, null deletes. The base hash and exact changes are recorded as input_derivation.
proposal.rationale: Explain the evidence supporting the selected model and remaining uncertainties.
proposal.scientific_reasoning: Required record described by scientific_reasoning below; modeled_step also declares reaction_center.

alternatives.reason_not_selected: Evidence that favors the selected setup

scientific_reasoning.selection_rationale: Why the evidence favors this hypothesis; address contrary evidence and transfer uncertainty

hypotheses.id: Unique hypothesis ID; declare at least two distinct competing hypotheses
hypotheses.statement: A testable mechanistic or modeling explanation
hypotheses.mechanism: Exact modeled_step.mechanism for the selected hypothesis
hypotheses.step_index: Positive integer; equals modeled_step.index for the selected hypothesis
hypotheses.step_description: Exact proxy-plan reaction_step for the selected hypothesis
hypotheses.reaction_center: atp_alpha | atp_gamma | carbonyl | other; equals modeled_step.reaction_center for the selected hypothesis
hypotheses.center_rationale: Evidence-grounded elementary step and reactive atom interpretation
assumptions: Explicit premise needed for this inference
uncertainties: A remaining uncertainty, including transfer or model limitations
hypotheses.evidence: Array of source_record objects plus effect: supports | contradicts | context. Unsupported alternatives may use []; the selected hypothesis requires supporting evidence before execution.

predictions.metric: Explicit numerical observable; pose_pass_fraction has an automatic controller adapter
predictions.endpoint: Exact endpoint; different endpoints are not compared
predictions.conditions: Explicit object describing the measurement conditions; exact matching is required
predictions.expected_interval: Two ordered finite numbers in declared units, frozen before observations
predictions.decision_if_refuted: Which modeling or proxy choice should be reconsidered

discriminating_test.measurement: An observation that distinguishes the explanations
discriminating_test.expected_if_alternative: Different expected outcome under the competing explanation
controls: Control for a confounder or measurement ambiguity

execution_rules: This object describes required fields; execution_rules is documentation, not a required proposal field.
For atp_alpha, every pose site uses electrophile PA and angle_reference O3A on the same ATP residue. For atp_gamma use PG and O3B. These are CCD names; other atom conventions require an adapter.
ATP proxy plans additionally declare context.reaction_center matching the selected hypothesis. Proxy mechanism and reaction_step match the selected hypothesis exactly.

Controller proxy extraction resolves exact atoms from validation_plan.poses.sites, including optional leaving_group and charge_centre references for descriptors that need them. Multisite models require proxy context.site_id. The extraction report records role_resolution.

The automatic pose_pass_fraction prediction uses scope structural, unit fraction, endpoint declared_pose_checks, conditions {basis: declared_ensemble}, and bounds in [0,1]. Missing samples/atoms or duplicate sample contents yield unresolved, not zero.

Proxy prediction metric proxy:<descriptor_id> uses scope structural, the exact catalog units, endpoint declared_proxy_plan, and conditions {parameters: <resolved extractor parameters>}. Only verified, complete computed extraction is compared; missing or partial extraction is unresolved.

inspect_reasoning returns assessment_sha256. After validation or observations, respond_to_reasoning_feedback requires that fingerprint, action retain|revise|investigate|abstain, rationale, addressed_hypotheses (selected and all contradicted), and next_test with the discriminating_test fields.

inspect_reasoning also returns response_hypothesis_ids. Legacy revisions without a scientific record use the explicit ID legacy_unrecorded to acknowledge historical feedback, then require a new proposal before execution or completion.

Only a current retain response permits further execution/completion. Other actions require investigation or a new revision. Respond before revising any prior feedback. A revise response must actually change the model or hypothesis record.

record_reasoning_observation accepts id, metric, scope, unit, endpoint, conditions, finite value, interpretation and one source_record in source. Source extraction/interpretation remain asserted. IDs cannot be overwritten. Unknown measurements should be investigated, not submitted as zero.

Optional measurement_interval is a pair of finite bounds containing value. Partial overlap with a prediction is unresolved; disjoint intervals contradict it. Structural observations default to applicability model and bind to their original model hash. Structural candidate applicability requires transfer_rationale. Experimental observations default to candidate applicability. Inapplicable evidence remains visible across revision.

compare_hypothesis_tests groups exactly matching readouts and identifies disjoint prediction intervals, prioritizing unresolved hypothesis pairs. Shared endpoints, units and conditions are required; touching or overlapping bounds do not separate hypotheses. It returns pairs_needing_new_predictions and declared controls. Priorities do not establish causal truth, feasibility, cost or Bayesian information gain.

All hypotheses, negative observations, prediction comparisons and responses persist across revisions and resume. A new revision cannot retroactively edit an earlier prediction interval. Intervals are declared scientific expectations, not fitted confidence intervals.

expected.protomer_chain_counts: Positive integers, one entry per protomer; their sum must match rendered protein chains
expected.active_sites: Explicit positive integer; do not infer from chains
expected.site_context: complete, only with evidence for the modeled ligand site

expected.chains: Ordered list of {source: full_sequence} or {source: sequence_range, start: integer, end: integer}; one-based inclusive precursor numbering
expected.precursor_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact full input amino-acid sequence

expected.species: Complete list, or explicit []; each entry needs ccd, role and exactly one of count_per_model or count_per_active_site

cofactors.evidence: Evidence for identities, stoichiometry and completeness for the chosen step

expected.components: All components in modeling_input.target_substrates, including excluded ones, with component_index, role, modeling_smiles, include_in_model

substrates.evidence: Evidence/rationale for molecular identity, modeled intermediate, protonation and stereochemistry

reaction_step.evidence: Evidence for this step's participants and reactive roles

poses.minimum_passing_predictions: Positive integer <= expected_predictions, justified for the intended use
poses.evidence: Reviewed source records supporting physical criteria and their scope
poses.sites: One entry per modeled active site: id, substrate_chain, nucleophile, electrophile, angle_reference, distance_range_A: [min,max], angle_range_deg: [min,max]. Atom references are {chain, residue, atom}. Angle reference need not be the leaving atom.
poses.distance_checks: Array of {id, a: atom_reference, b: atom_reference, range_A: [min,max]}; include a required contact for each cofactor chain
poses.coordination_checks: For every metal chain: {id, center: atom_reference, element, donors: [atom_reference], distance_range_A: [min,max], donor_count_range: [min,max]}. Assesses only the declared modeled donors; omitted hydration is unresolved physical context.
poses.interfaces: For multichain models: {id, chains: [chain1,chain2], contact_radius_A, minimum_residue_pairs}. All protein chains must be connected by declared interfaces.

protein_atom_policy.allowed_missing: Optional list of {chain,residue,atom,rationale,evidence}. Records omissions; never grants a completeness pass for required heavy atoms. Hydrogens and OXT are outside the required inventory.
protein_atom_policy.modified_residues: Optional list of {resname,heavy_atoms,rationale,evidence}. Names must be distinct nonstandard residues; explicit heavy-atom inventories include N,CA,C,O. Unrecognized/unsupported chemistry remains unresolved; declarations do not establish chemical truth.

source_record.path: Existing UTF-8 source snapshot, preferably an absolute path
source_record.quote: Exact supporting passage present in the snapshot
source_record.rationale: Explain how the passage supports this particular expectation, including transfer limitations and contradictions

limits: Source fingerprints and exact passages establish traceability, not semantic entailment.
Self-generated hypotheses and poses cannot independently validate their own setup.
No universal metal, assembly, reaction angle, contact cutoff or pose count is supplied.
Additional hypotheses can be explored as separate revisions; a failed check does not establish enzyme inactivity.
